about: WorkSync ek modern task management platform hai jahan teams tasks create, assign, track aur verify kar sakti hain. Iska focus speed, clarity, aur accountability par hai.

faq.a: WorkSync ek collaborative task management app hai jo admin aur users ko end-to-end task workflow manage karne me help karta hai.
Do primary roles hote hain: admin aur user. Admin tasks assign/verify/manage karta hai, user assigned tasks execute aur submit karta hai.
Typical flow: pending -> in_progress -> submitted -> verified. Exceptional states: rejected, cancelled, due.
Haan, task create/update aur submission flows me file upload supported hai (size/type validations ke saath).

faq.q: Chatbot se kya kya kar sakte hain?
faq.a: Chatbot se tasks list/filter, quick create, title/due/file update, assign, aur status-related actions perform kiye ja sakte hain (permissions ke hisaab se).
Aap support@worksync.app par email kar sakte hain. Working hours: Mon-Sat, 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM IST.
WorkSync authenticated access, role-based permissions aur backend validations use karta hai. Sensitive actions me confirmation aur access checks apply hote hain.
